sources.observed: Three square hip-roof pavilions interrupt long narrow tiled covered walkway. Four small pale roof protrusions visible on each pavilion; hip seams visible. Trees obscure lower supports. Acquisition date not exposed; copyright2026 not capture date.
Open elevated walkway and pale piers partly visible behind dense trees; roof details obscured. Not a height measurement.
Eastern approach: pale pavilion/corridor with balustrades and glazed/arced end, largely tree-obscured. No precise roof-vent dimensions established.
Southern concave tiled roof with visible radial hip seams and curving ridge; two pale small fixtures on eastern slope. Adjacent dome and flat service roof separate. Acquisition date not exposed.
Northern rectangular hip roof has four diagonal hip seams meeting short north/south ridge and dark rectangular framed rooflight on western slope. Acquisition date not exposed.
